name: Digital Sunset: Screens Off an Hour Early
equipment: None -- a plan for the evening, and something screen-free to do instead
instructions: Set every screen (phone, TV, laptop, tablet) aside a full hour before bed tonight.
Replace that hour with something screen-free and calm: reading on paper, stretching, journaling, or a warm shower.
Notice if you fall asleep faster or wake up feeling more rested -- most people find even one screen-free hour makes a real difference.
Close the hour with tonight's wind-down meditation.
